# Reference photographs

The vectors in `vectors/` were derived by `generate.py` from these
photographs. They are NASA photographs, in the public domain in the United
States (17 U.S.C. § 105; NASA's media usage guidelines), taken by NASA at the
Johnson Space Center and found through the NASA Image and Video Library API.
The photographs are **not** committed: only numbers derived by running
NudeNet on them are (docs/71 §9.6). Re-download them from the URLs below
to regenerate.
